description: NVDA Piper Driver is a maintained NVDA 2026 AMD64 adaptation of Sonata Neural Voices, originally developed by Musharraf Omer. It provides local neural Piper voices, bundled offline starter voices, and an accessible Voice Manager for installing additional voices.
